annotations.title: Get a notification when a phone number changes

description: Set up a notification about a toll free or local phone number for a person who wants an email when it changes: a number they want that someone has today, or a local number whose block no phone company has been given yet. Use it when the person asks to be told about a number and gives their email address. VanityNumbers.com emails them a link to confirm, and nothing starts until they click it. Then they get what we have on it now. A toll free number is followed with the same 7 digits in all 7 toll free area codes; a local number with every version of it in its state, a check each month of whether it's still in use, and, if no phone company has its block yet, when our data shows one was given it. After that they get an email on the 15th when it or a related number has changed, and every three months to say the notification is still on. Returns whether the confirm email went out. It can't buy or reserve a number.

email.description: The person's email address. The confirm email and the notifications go there.
email.title: Email

name.description: Optional: the person's first name, for the emails.
name.title: Name

number.description: The number to be notified about, by digits or spelling, like 844-758-6237, 844-PLUMBER or 512-758-6237.
